title: Nourishing Crisp Indian Vegetables Pav Bhaji
description: A sour and crisp Indian dish featuring a mix of vegetables, pav bhaji style, with a hint of honey and an al-dente finish, perfect for a midnight craving. This flexitarian-friendly dish is a twist on the classic pav bhaji.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pan over medium heat until it melts and starts to foam.
Add the chopped onion and saute until it turns translucent and starts to caramelize.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until it starts to break down and the mixture becomes sauce-like.
Add the grated carrot, peas, and cauliflower, and cook until the vegetables are al-dente.
Stir in the pav bhaji masala and cook for 1-2 minutes until the mixture is fragrant.
Add the honey and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt to taste.
Split the pav in half and toast until crispy and golden brown.
Assemble the pav bhaji by spooning the vegetable mixture onto the toasted pav.
